inputs.label: Near infrared
inputs.coverage: NEAR MSI filter 4 albedo at 950 nm, from the 2023 deblurred release. The near-infrared map is corrected to zero phase and shown in grayscale with the same 0.05–0.40 reflectance range as the 550 nm view. Differences between the views include wavelength-dependent reflectance; this is not natural color or a mineral-abundance measurement. Missing source pixels use the gray grid.
